author: CollinRugg
text:
A very emotional middle-aged liberal woman freaks out after a Ken Paxton volunteer showed up at her home.

Woman: Are you with Ken Paxton?

Man: I am.

Woman: Get the hell out of my yard.

She probably has a 'Kindness is Everything' sign in her front yard.
